risks.title: Catastrophes naturelles et changement climatique
risks.summary: Zurich Insurance is directly exposed to rising losses from natural catastrophes (floods, hurricanes, droughts, wildfires). Pricing models must adapt to a more volatile climate, or else face deteriorating P&C margins.
risks.summary_en: Zurich Insurance is directly exposed to rising losses from natural catastrophes (floods, hurricanes, droughts, fires). Pricing models must adapt to a more volatile climate, or face deteriorating P&C margins.
risks.score_rationale: Natural catastrophes cited as a core concern by Chair (Annual Report 2023). Climate change presented as "perhaps the most complex risk society is facing". Direct impact on P&C combined ratio of 94.5%. Frequency and severity of claims in structural increase.
risks.score_rationale_en: Natural catastrophes cited as a central concern by Chair (Annual Report 2023). Climate change described as "perhaps the most complex risk society is facing". Direct impact on P&C combined ratio of 94.5%. Claim frequency and severity in structural increase.

risks.title: Risques d'IA générative et éthique technologique
risks.title_en: Generative AI and Technological Ethics Risks
risks.summary: The rapid adoption of generative AI (ChatGPT) poses risks of malicious use (disinformation, fraud), algorithmic bias, and requires enhanced Board governance (AI Assurance Framework). Impact on underwriting, claims management, and fraud.
risks.summary_en: The rapid adoption of generative AI (ChatGPT) poses risks of malicious use (disinformation, fraud), algorithmic bias, and requires strengthened Board governance (AI Assurance Framework). Impact on underwriting, claims management, and fraud.
risks.score_rationale: AI Assurance Framework cited as a Board priority for 2023. Global Risks Report 2024 (co-developed with WEF) ranks 'adverse outcomes from AI' among top risks. Internal adoption for underwriting, but risks to clients and operations.
risks.score_rationale_en: AI Assurance Framework cited as a 2023 Board priority. Global Risks Report 2024 (co-developed with WEF) ranks 'adverse outcomes from AI' among top risks. Internal adoption for underwriting, but risks to clients and operations.

risks.title: Incertitude géopolitique et conflits régionaux
risks.summary: The Russia-Ukraine and Middle East conflicts, combined with major elections in 2024, are creating increased market and trade chain volatility. Zurich operates in over 200 countries, with broad exposure to sanctions, restrictions, and economic disruptions.
risks.summary_en: The Russia-Ukraine and Middle East conflicts, combined with major elections in 2024, create increased market and supply chain volatility. Zurich operates in over 200 countries, with broad exposure to sanctions, restrictions, and economic disruptions.
risks.score_rationale: Chair explicitly lists Russia-Ukraine war, Israel-Gaza conflict, and 2024 elections (India, UK, EU, US presidential). 'Increasingly precarious geopolitical landscape'. Impact on operations across 200+ countries.
risks.score_rationale_en: Chair explicitly lists Russia-Ukraine war, Israel-Gaza conflict, and 2024 elections (India, UK, EU, US presidential). 'Increasingly precarious geopolitical landscape'. Impact on operations across 200+ countries.

risks.title: Financial markets and interest rate volatility
risks.title_en: Financial Market and Interest Rate Volatility
risks.summary: The 171 Bn USD investment portfolio is sensitive to interest rate movements, credit spreads, and equity markets. A sharp rise in rates or a credit crisis could affect equity and the SST (Swiss Solvency Test) ratio.
risks.summary_en: The 171 Bn USD investment portfolio is sensitive to interest rate movements, credit spreads, and equity markets. A sharp rise in rates or a credit crisis could impact equity and the SST ratio (Swiss Solvency Test).
risks.score_rationale: Investment portfolio of USD 171.2bn (2023). SST ratio 233% but sensitive to long-term interest rates. S&P rating AA/stable as baseline. Business operating profit (BOP) explicitly defined to exclude financial volatility.
risks.score_rationale_en: Investment portfolio of USD 171.2bn (2023). SST ratio of 233% but sensitive to long-term rates. S&P rating AA/stable as foundation. Business operating profit (BOP) explicitly defined to exclude financial volatility.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and customer data protection
risks.summary: Zurich holds sensitive data (health, financial) from millions of individual and corporate customers. Cyberattacks on insurers are rising (ransomware, data theft). A major breach could result in GDPR fines, class-action lawsuits, and loss of trust.
risks.summary_en: Zurich holds sensitive data (health, financial) from millions of individual and corporate clients. Cyberattacks on insurers are rising (ransomware, data theft). A major breach could lead to GDPR fines, class-action lawsuits, and loss of trust.
risks.score_rationale: Data from 1.25 million customers in the 2023 NPS program. Global insurance company = prime target for cyberattacks. AI Assurance Framework also covers data governance. Not explicitly mentioned in Chair's top risk but high structural risk.
risks.score_rationale_en: Data from 1.25 million clients in 2023 NPS program. Global insurer = prime target for cyberattacks. AI Assurance Framework also covers data governance. Not explicitly in Chair's top risks but structurally high risk.
